source_modifications.subject: Add rustia conformance base
source_modifications.why_it_could_not_be_measured: The root Cargo.toml predates bench/, so the overlaid harness crate was undeclared; and this revision has no public Vm::call_function, the entry point a fixed harness needs to call a workload's returned function. That entry point was added by the very next commit (aee7749), the commit that introduced the harness.
changes_applied: Added "bench" to the root Cargo.toml workspace members.
source_modifications.why_the_timing_is_still_this_revision: The wrapper reads settings.initial_fuel, calls call_value, and returns first_result_or_nil. All three already exist at this revision with matching signatures, so the wrapper exposes existing machinery and adds no behaviour.
source_modifications.verification: All five workload checksums match the other 74 revisions exactly.
